source_text.body:
Build morning routine and vacuum automations
A commenter had Claude help build a button-triggered morning routine for their daughter and a robot vacuum dispatch when the litter box cycles.
·
Oct 24, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
The commenter used an Aqara Wireless Mini Switch in Home Assistant as a physical trigger. A single press runs a time-based routine: in the morning it slowly raises lights, plays a reminder, and starts a playlist; at night it slowly lowers lights, plays an evening reminder, starts a bedtime playlist, and locks any exterior doors still unlocked. In the same setup, a litter-box cycle sends the Roborock to vacuum in front of it unless the game room is occupied or media is playing on the living-room TV.
How it went
They describe these as their favorite automations, with the litter-box flow also changing a nearby closet light to red when the waste bin is getting close to full. No performance numbers or failure cases were given.
Worth knowing
The concrete hardware detail is the Aqara Wireless Mini Switch; the vacuum run is gated by room-occupancy and TV-playback checks.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Help me create two Home Assistant automations. First, a morning routine for my [child] triggered by pressing [button or device] that does [lights, music, announcements, etc.]. Second, send my robot vacuum [model] to clean when [trigger, e.g. the litter box finishes a cycle]. Give me the YAML with my entity names as placeholders, explain how to find the right entities, and stop when I have both automations ready to paste in and test.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/homeassistant/comments/1wsrnwc/what_is_your_best_automationscriptscene_this_is
